facts.text: 14.2.5: breach of the non-disparagement obligation (clause 16) is a ground for termination; clause 16 survives termination.
Responsible-trading measures can lead to adverse measures on accounts; automated or AI-assisted decisions can be reviewed, and a measure not confirmed on review is reversed.
On closure of the client account, amounts already determined remain payable except where the determination was procured by fraud or the trading data is tainted by a breach of the Trading Rules.
